findings.detail: use_kl_loss=True and coefficient0; rewards and loss do not consume reference. Input contracts and finite field checks still require it.
Full840-file SHA re-read per _native_run; four candidate waves + two driver calls + eight workers =14 passes. Two passes inside unclassified step and eight inside actor.
Context audit and probability projection repeat full2560 trace verification/canonical hashes; raw trace synchronous serialization and fsync before reference.
Eight fields times320 rows per rank hashed through detach.cpu; worker inputs already onGPU. Exact hashes still required, but batch transfers avoid thousands of small D2H syncs.

Single GPU micro4; commit and boundary each2560 inputs =>1280 full model forwards. Boundary G5 prompt duplicates uncollapsed. Hook captures intermediate layer but later layers still execute; actual readout layer not yet read.

160training fw+bw and80 extra monitor forward/rank/outer; many finite/FP64 scans, collective scalars and per-row durable ledgers. These are also present in current A800 code, not independently an H100-vs-A800 cause.
Coefficient0 disables entropy gradient but retains expensive full-vocabulary entropy computation; contributes no objective gradient.
